var today = new Date();
var dateStr = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
var dayName = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][today.getDay()];

var tasks = $input.all().map(function(item) { return item.json; });
var asanaData = {
  tasks_due_today: tasks.filter(function(t) { return t.due_on === dateStr; }).map(function(t) { return t.name; }),
  overdue: tasks.filter(function(t) { return t.due_on && t.due_on < dateStr; }).map(function(t) { return t.name; }),
  upcoming: tasks.filter(function(t) { return t.due_on && t.due_on > dateStr; }).slice(0, 10).map(function(t) { return t.name + ' (due: ' + t.due_on + ')'; }),
  no_due_date: tasks.filter(function(t) { return !t.due_on; }).map(function(t) { return t.name; })
};
var slackData = { unread_dms: [], mentions: [], note: 'Slack data not yet connected' };
var gmailData = { action_required: [], unread_count: 0, note: 'Gmail data not yet connected' };

var promptLines = [
  '# Morning Briefing',
  '',
  'Generate a concise morning briefing for Nelson Torres at AdQuadrant.',
  'Today is ' + dayName + ', ' + dateStr + '.',
  '',
  '## Data Sources',
  '',
  '### Asana Tasks',
  JSON.stringify(asanaData),
  '',
  '### Slack (last 24h)',
  JSON.stringify(slackData),
  '',
  '### Gmail',
  JSON.stringify(gmailData),
  '',
  '## Output Format',
  '',
  '### Needs Action Today',
  'Ranked by urgency + effort. Include source and brief context.',
  '',
  '### On Your Radar',
  'Due soon, waiting on others, FYI threads worth knowing.',
  '',
  '### Inbox Summary',
  'Slack + email items condensed. Paraphrase, never verbatim.',
  '',
  '## Rules',
  '- Keep under 40 lines total',
  '- Do not list completed tasks',
  '- If nothing is urgent, say so',
  '- Cross-reference Slack/email threads connected to Asana tasks'
];
var systemPrompt = promptLines.join('\n');

return [{ json: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
  max_tokens: 2048,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'Generate the morning briefing for ' + dayName + ' ' + dateStr + '.'
  }]
}}];
